subject: Fortified boundary architecture + evidence request for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Olivia Park <security@veridian.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture & evidence request: network boundaries for Dedicated/Private

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — Veridian is moving toward a dedicated deployment for a subset of workloads and our internal audit team has asked for a concise architecture pack that covers network segregation and control-plane isolation for both Dedicated and Private modes. Specifically we need:

- A redacted network diagram that shows: control plane, data plane, management plane (VPC boundaries, peering/interconnect, egress controls).
- A segregation/control matrix showing what is in shared vs dedicated tenancy and how traffic is routed.
- Brief notes on KMS boundaries and whether customer-managed keys are supported for the control plane.
- SOC 2 snapshot or redacted evidence (audit report excerpts are fine) and a filled SIG/CAIQ if available.

Target: can we get a first-pass bundle by EOD 2027-06-22? We need something we can hand our auditors. If you prefer, we can do a short call to walk through the diagram.

Appreciate it —
Olivia Park
Head of Vendor Risk
Veridian Financial
security@veridian.com

--
Note: this mailbox is monitored by Veridian IT for change control requests.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <security@veridian.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 13:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture & evidence request: network boundaries for Dedicated/Private

Olivia —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached a high-level redacted diagram that should satisfy the auditors for an initial review (attachment: fortified-boundary-arch-v3.pdf). Short answers up front: control plane services run in a customer-dedicated control VPC for Private deployments and in logically segregated control subnets for Dedicated; management APIs are not exposed to public internet; we support customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest in Private deployments (details in the SOC snapshot).

Next steps I propose:
- I'll share the diagram (attached) and a segregation matrix internally so we can produce the CAIQ/SIG responses.
- Can we schedule a 30-min walk-through Monday to answer any follow-ups?

I'll loop in our security & compliance leads to pull the SOC2 snapshot and the segregation matrix.

Attachment: fortified-boundary-arch-v3.pdf (redacted diagram, 2 pages)

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding Veridian's ask (below). Quick summary and owners I recommend:

What they need (copied):
- Redacted network diagram: control/data/management planes, VPC boundaries, peering/interconnect, egress controls.
- Segregation/control matrix: what is shared vs dedicated, routing policies.
- KMS boundary notes + support for customer-managed keys.
- SOC 2 snapshot + SIG/CAIQ responses if we have an existing export.

Proposed owners:
- Karthik: populate the SIG/CAIQ export and pull the SOC2 redacted snapshot (we usually use the redacted PDF we keep in the security drive).
- Stephanie: refine the segregation-control-matrix.xlsx (attached) with columns for control plane, data plane, management plane, and note references to playbooks/runbooks.
- Me: deliver the redacted architecture PDF and host the walkthrough for their auditors.

Action items + timeline: can we have the SIG/CAIQ draft and SOC snapshot by COB Monday (2027-06-21)? Olivia requested a first-pass by EOD 06/22 but internal reviewers prefer to sign off earlier.

Attachments: segregation-control-matrix.xlsx (1 sheet — draft).

Notes: for Private deployments the control plane is on a logically isolated control VPC with peering restricted to customer-managed transit. For Dedicated the control plane is colocated on dedicated subnets with explicit routing policies that prevent tenant cross-talk; management APIs are reachable only via internal management endpoints (no direct public endpoints). Please add exact references to the runbooks (Confluence link below) and mark any items that need redaction for public auditors.

Related links: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Security/Fortified+Boundary+Notes

Thanks —
Marcus

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the quick response and the draft diagram. A couple of clarifying questions from our auditors before the walkthrough:

1) Control plane routing: for Private deployments can you confirm that management APIs (e.g., deploy, key rotation endpoints) are restricted to a management VPC and routed only over the customer-controlled interconnect? In other words, will any management API traffic ever transit public internet?

2) KMS boundary: can you provide a short paragraph describing how customer-managed keys are bound to the tenant context and where the key material is stored (e.g., HSM vs cloud KMS)? If there are restrictions for Dedicated vs Private, please call them out.

3) Redaction: the auditors prefer a single redacted PDF we can attach to a CAIQ submission (no internal IPs, no account IDs). Can you confirm you can produce the redacted SOC2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-snapshot-redacted.pdf) and the segregation matrix in spreadsheet form?

If those three items are doable by tomorrow EOD, we can proceed with the audit intake. Otherwise please propose the earliest time.

Olivia Park
Head of Vendor Risk
Veridian Financial
